question: give me risk analysis of the school
sql: SELECT risk_area, risk_indicator, issue_count, severity, recommended_action FROM ( SELECT 'Academic & attendance' AS risk_area, 'Students below 75% attendance (month)' AS risk_indicator, COUNT(*) AS issue_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN 'High' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS severity, 'Review class attendance; contact guardians' AS recommended_action FROM (SELECT s.id FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date)=MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date)=YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY s.id HAVING ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(at.type, '')) IN ('p','present','1') OR LOWER(COALESCE(at.long_lang_name, '')) LIKE '%present%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2)<75) t UNION ALL SELECT 'Finance','Students with outstanding fees',COUNT(*), CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>=10 THEN 'High' WHEN COUNT(*)>=3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END, 'Fee reminders and class-wise collection drive' FROM (SELECT s.id FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id=s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id=ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id,SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd,JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail,'$.*' COLUMNS(amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id=sfm.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount),0)-COALESCE(SUM(p.paid),0)>0) f UNION ALL SELECT 'Operations','Open complaints',COUNT(*), CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>=3 THEN 'High' WHEN COUNT(*)>=1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END, 'Close complaint loop with owners' FROM complaint WHERE action_taken IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(action_taken,''))='' ) r WHERE issue_count > 0 ORDER BY FIELD(severity,'High','Medium','Low'), issue_count DESC LIMIT 12

question: show attendance summary per student this month
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(at.type, '')) IN ('p','present','1') OR LOWER(COALESCE(at.long_lang_name, '')) LIKE '%present%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS present_days, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(at.type, '')) IN ('a','absent') OR LOWER(COALESCE(at.long_lang_name, '')) LIKE '%absent%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent_days, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(at.type, '')) IN ('l','late') OR LOWER(COALESCE(at.long_lang_name, '')) LIKE '%late%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_days, COUNT(*) AS days_marked, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(at.type, '')) IN ('p','present','1') OR LOWER(COALESCE(at.long_lang_name, '')) LIKE '%present%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS attendance_percent FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY s.id, student_name ORDER BY attendance_percent DESC LIMIT 50

question: show fee collection this month

question: show paid vs due fees by student
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) AS total_due, COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS total_paid, (COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0)) AS balance FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id, s.admission_no, s.firstname, s.lastname ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 50

question: explain overall grade distribution for grade 1 final exam
sql: SELECT g.name AS grade_letter, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM (SELECT egbs.id, ROUND(100 * SUM(COALESCE(CAST(eger.get_marks AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(CAST(egcbes.max_marks AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 0)), 0), 2) AS pct FROM exam_group_class_batch_exam_students egbs INNER JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = egbs.student_session_id INNER JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id INNER JOIN exam_group_class_batch_exams egcbe ON egcbe.id = egbs.exam_group_class_batch_exam_id INNER JOIN exam_group_class_batch_exam_subjects egcbes ON egcbes.exam_group_class_batch_exams_id = egcbe.id LEFT JOIN exam_group_exam_results eger ON eger.exam_group_class_batch_exam_student_id = egbs.id AND eger.exam_group_class_batch_exam_subject_id = egcbes.id WHERE (c.class = '1' OR c.class = 'Grade 1' OR c.class = 'Class 1') AND LOWER(egcbe.exam) LIKE '%final%' GROUP BY egbs.id HAVING pct IS NOT NULL) st JOIN grades g ON st.pct >= g.mark_upto AND st.pct <= g.mark_from GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY g.mark_upto ASC

question: list students by blood group

question: show count of behaviour incidents per student

question: show behaviour incidents for grade 7 section B
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sb.title, sb.description, sb.point, si.created_at FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id WHERE (c.class = '7' OR c.class = 'Grade 7' OR c.class = 'Class 7') AND sec.section = 'B' ORDER BY si.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: which teachers teach mathematics

question: show library books grouped by category

question: list students promoted to next class

question: how many students have remaining fees

question: which student offline bank payment is in pending

question: what is the total remaining fee amount across all students
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) AS total_billed, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt), 0) AS total_paid, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt), 0) AS total_outstanding FROM student_fees_master sfm

question: Show lesson plan for Grade 1 Section A Subject Group Core Subjects Subject English (Eng)
sql: SELECT c.class AS grade, sec.section, sg.name AS subject_group, subj.name AS subject_name, subj.code AS subject_code, l.name AS lesson_name, t.name AS topic_name, CASE WHEN t.status = '1' THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'Incomplete' END AS topic_status, CASE WHEN t.complete_date IS NOT NULL AND t.complete_date > '1000-01-01' THEN t.complete_date ELSE NULL END AS completion_date FROM lesson l INNER JOIN topic t ON t.lesson_id = l.id INNER JOIN subject_group_subjects sgs ON sgs.id = l.subject_group_subject_id INNER JOIN subjects subj ON subj.id = sgs.subject_id INNER JOIN subject_groups sg ON sg.id = sgs.subject_group_id INNER JOIN subject_group_class_sections sgcs ON sgcs.id = l.subject_group_class_sections_id INNER JOIN class_sections cs ON cs.id = sgcs.class_section_id INNER JOIN classes c ON c.id = cs.class_id INNER JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = cs.section_id WHERE sgcs.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM sch_settings LIMIT 1) AND t.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM sch_settings LIMIT 1) AND (c.class = '1' OR c.class = 'Grade 1' OR c.class = 'Class 1') AND UPPER(sec.section) = 'A' AND LOWER(sg.name) LIKE LOWER('%Core Subjects%') AND (LOWER(subj.name) LIKE LOWER('%English%') OR LOWER(subj.code) LIKE LOWER('%Eng%')) ORDER BY l.id, t.id LIMIT 200

question: show single choice questions with tag grammar from question bank of online courses
sql: SELECT q.id, q.question, q.question_type, q.level, q.opt_a, q.opt_b, q.opt_c, q.opt_d, q.opt_e, q.correct, t.tag_name AS question_tag, CONCAT_WS(' ', st.name, st.surname) AS created_by FROM online_course_exam_question q LEFT JOIN online_course_tag t ON t.id = q.question_tag LEFT JOIN staff st ON st.id = q.staff_id WHERE q.question_type = 'singlechoice' AND LOWER(t.tag_name) LIKE LOWER('%grammar%') ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 50

question: show active fee discounts

question: show students receiving financial discount with reason
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, fd.name AS discount_name, fd.code AS discount_code, fd.type AS discount_type, fd.percentage, fd.amount, COALESCE(NULLIF(sfdisc.description, ''), fd.description, fd.name) AS discount_reason, sfdisc.status AS assignment_status FROM student_fees_discounts sfdisc JOIN fees_discounts fd ON fd.id = sfdisc.fees_discount_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfdisc.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id WHERE s.is_active = 'yes' ORDER BY s.firstname, fd.name LIMIT 50

question: show may fee collection class-wise
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS paying_students, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS total_collected FROM student_fees_deposite sfd JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.id = sfd.student_fees_master_id JOIN fee_session_groups fsg ON fsg.id = sfm.fee_session_group_id JOIN fee_groups fg ON fg.id = fsg.fee_groups_id JOIN fee_groups_feetype fgf ON fgf.id = sfd.fee_groups_feetype_id JOIN feetype ft ON ft.id = fgf.feetype_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date', payment_mode VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.payment_mode', amount_discount VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount_discount', inv_no VARCHAR(20) PATH '$.inv_no', collected_by VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.collected_by')) AS jt WHERE s.is_active = 'yes' AND CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0 AND MONTH(COALESCE(jt.payment_date, DATE(sfd.created_at))) = 5 AND YEAR(COALESCE(jt.payment_date, DATE(sfd.created_at))) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY c.class ORDER BY total_collected DESC LIMIT 50

question: show fees paid by mohammed al qahtani
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, fg.name AS fee_group, ft.type AS fee_type, CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS amount_paid, CAST(COALESCE(jt.amount_discount, '0') AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS discount, jt.payment_mode, COALESCE(jt.payment_date, DATE(sfd.created_at)) AS payment_date, jt.inv_no, jt.collected_by FROM student_fees_deposite sfd JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.id = sfd.student_fees_master_id JOIN fee_session_groups fsg ON fsg.id = sfm.fee_session_group_id JOIN fee_groups fg ON fg.id = fsg.fee_groups_id JOIN fee_groups_feetype fgf ON fgf.id = sfd.fee_groups_feetype_id JOIN feetype ft ON ft.id = fgf.feetype_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date', payment_mode VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.payment_mode', amount_discount VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount_discount', inv_no VARCHAR(20) PATH '$.inv_no', collected_by VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.collected_by')) AS jt WHERE (LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE '%mohammed%' OR LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE '%muhammad%' OR LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE '%mohamed%') AND LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE '%al%' AND LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE '%qahtani%' AND CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(jt.payment_date, DATE(sfd.created_at)) DESC LIMIT 100

question: show recent fee payments
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, fg.name AS fee_group, ft.type AS fee_type, CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS amount_paid, CAST(COALESCE(jt.amount_discount, '0') AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS discount, jt.payment_mode, COALESCE(jt.payment_date, DATE(sfd.created_at)) AS payment_date, jt.inv_no, jt.collected_by FROM student_fees_deposite sfd JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.id = sfd.student_fees_master_id JOIN fee_session_groups fsg ON fsg.id = sfm.fee_session_group_id JOIN fee_groups fg ON fg.id = fsg.fee_groups_id JOIN fee_groups_feetype fgf ON fgf.id = sfd.fee_groups_feetype_id JOIN feetype ft ON ft.id = fgf.feetype_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date', payment_mode VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.payment_mode', amount_discount VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount_discount', inv_no VARCHAR(20) PATH '$.inv_no', collected_by VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.collected_by')) AS jt WHERE s.is_active = 'yes' AND CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(jt.payment_date, DATE(sfd.created_at)) DESC, s.firstname LIMIT 20
